name: ai-gateway
description: AI Gateway — multi-tenant LLM proxy + admin API + dashboard (monorepo)

scripts.dev:local:stop-app: docker compose --profile app stop admin proxy dashboard
scripts.dev:local:admin: sh -c 'set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; NODE_ENV=development DATABASE_URL="postgres://${POSTGRES_USER:-ai_gateway}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-ai_gateway_dev}@localhost:5433/${POSTGRES_DB:-ai_gateway}" REDIS_URL="redis://localhost:6380" CONFIG_SOURCE="${CONFIG_SOURCE:-db}" TENANT_SLUG="${TENANT_SLUG:-default}" ADMIN_TOKEN="${ADMIN_TOKEN:-dev-admin-token}" PORT=7780 HOST=0.0.0.0 BETTER_AUTH_URL="${BETTER_AUTH_URL:-http://localhost:7780}" CORS_ORIGIN="${CORS_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:7790,http://localhost:3000}" KIRO_ACCOUNTS_DIR="${KIRO_ACCOUNTS_DIR:-$PWD/.dev-data/kiro-accounts}" GEMINI_ACCOUNTS_DIR="${GEMINI_ACCOUNTS_DIR:-$PWD/.dev-data/gemini-accounts}" PROXY_SCRAPER_BIN="${PROXY_SCRAPER_BIN:-$PWD/apps/proxy/tools/scraper/proxy-scraper}" pnpm --filter @ai-gateway/admin dev'
scripts.dev:local:proxy: sh -c 'set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; NODE_ENV=development DATABASE_URL="postgres://${POSTGRES_USER:-ai_gateway}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-ai_gateway_dev}@localhost:5433/${POSTGRES_DB:-ai_gateway}" REDIS_URL="redis://localhost:6380" CONFIG_SOURCE="${CONFIG_SOURCE:-db}" TENANT_SLUG="${TENANT_SLUG:-default}" PORT=7777 HOST=0.0.0.0 LOG_LEVEL="${LOG_LEVEL:-info}" KIRO_ACCOUNTS_DIR="${KIRO_ACCOUNTS_DIR:-$PWD/.dev-data/kiro-accounts}" GEMINI_ACCOUNTS_DIR="${GEMINI_ACCOUNTS_DIR:-$PWD/.dev-data/gemini-accounts}" pnpm --filter @ai-gateway/proxy dev'
scripts.dev:local: sh -c 'trap "kill 0" INT TERM EXIT; pnpm run dev:local:admin & pnpm run dev:local:proxy & pnpm run dev:local:dashboard & wait'
scripts.dash:dev: docker compose stop dashboard 2>/dev/null; docker compose run --rm -p 7790:7790 -w /workspace/apps/dashboard db-tools pnpm dev
scripts.dash:rebuild: docker compose --profile app build dashboard && docker compose --profile app up -d dashboard
scripts.admin:dev: docker compose stop admin 2>/dev/null; docker compose run --rm -p 7780:7780 -w /workspace/apps/admin db-tools pnpm dev
scripts.admin:rebuild: docker compose --profile app build admin && docker compose --profile app up -d admin
scripts.proxy:dev: docker compose stop proxy 2>/dev/null; docker compose run --rm -p 7777:7777 -w /workspace/apps/proxy db-tools pnpm dev
scripts.proxy:rebuild: docker compose --profile app build proxy && docker compose --profile app up -d proxy
